lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too high across all five initial tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Evidence is still thin for all individual kinds of changes (adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, home new_flow, sign_in hint) as each has only been tested once so far.

candidates.title: Interactive Split Pet Selector
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout with a live pet preview component.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion, 89s median) and support reported issues with pet generation results.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Persistence Clarification
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint and explanatory note to the sign-in screen warning users about signing into the correct account.
candidates.why: The top support theme with 8 emails involved missing or reset pets due to re-signing into wrong or different accounts.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account to keep your saved pets across desktop sessions.

components.text: Using your main account ensures your pet progress is never reset.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory hint and note to the sign-in screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Top support theme (8 emails), but past sign_in hint test produced a negative lift (-0.9%).

candidates.title: Estimated Wait Time Indicator
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and readiness notifications on the waiting screen while the pet is generated.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has the longest mean wait duration (2336s), causing drop-offs before users complete setup.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Life
waiting.body: We are preparing your desktop pet. You can minimize this window while you wait.

guard.reason: Enabling a time estimate during a real generation wait complies with Rule 5 and waiting screen requirements.

candidates.score_note: Funnel highlights extreme mean wait time (2336s); wait time indicator reduces uncertainty drop-offs.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated controls screen right after home intro explaining how to move, hide, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails noted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

new_pet_controls.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_controls.body: Click and drag to position your pet. Right-click the pet anytime to open the menu to hide, feed, or chat.

guard.reason: Adding a controls guide screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen to finish step previously reduced conversion (-3.0%) despite support complaints.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Live Preview Flow
candidates.change: Insert a preview sub-flow screen before photo uploading so users see sample results before committing photos.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pets failing or looking wrong, causing user friction during the adoption step.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview Your Custom Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Here is a preview of how custom companions look on your desktop background.

guard.reason: Inserting a preview sub-flow before photo upload is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has lowest completion (60.9%) and support issues, though new screens add friction.

candidates.title: Spotlight Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switch choose_path layout to spotlight to give equal visual weight and focus to both standard and custom paths.
candidates.why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite median 8s, indicating some users stall selecting a path.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Adoption Path
choose_path.body: Pick a quick starter pet or create a unique custom companion from scratch.

guard.reason: Spotlight layout redesign maintains both adoption and custom pet creation paths as required by Rule 2.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesign showed strongest past historical lift (+4.2%), addressing mean completion time outlier.

candidates.title: Desktop Arrival Quick Reference
candidates.change: Update home_intro text to clearly state that the pet is now visible on the screen and give quick tips.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop / app not opening, and 3 emails asked how to interact.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Right-click the pet at any time to open settings or hide it.

guard.reason: Updating onboarding home_intro copy to provide arrival tips is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targeted text update addresses 6 support emails at high cost-efficiency without adding full screen friction.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Deferred Sign In
candidates.change: Move sign-in to take place after pet selection and waiting, right before onboarding finishes.
candidates.why: Asking users to sign in early (step 2) creates drop-off (72.9%) before users experience pet customization.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to save your customized pet so it stays available across sessions.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to after waiting and adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Deferring early sign-in barrier (72.9% drop) can increase early onboarding progression significantly.

candidates.title: Background Wait Notification Alert
candidates.change: Add desktop readiness notification enabling and background processing badge on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The average waiting step time is over 38 minutes (2336s), leading to user drop-offs if they close the app.

guard.reason: Adding background wait notifications and status badges on the waiting screen complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets the 38+ minute mean waiting drop-off by keeping users engaged asynchronously.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Clarity Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent quality guideline hint and badge on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Users wrote to support about custom pet creation failing or producing bad visual results.

upload_photos.hint: Upload front-facing, well-lit photos for the cleanest desktop pet render.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results in most tests, though the round 2 sign_in hint was under-predicted.
sign_in hint changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests.
choose_path redesign produced the only winning test so far, but evidence for this kind of change is still thin with only 1 test.
finish new_screen made performance worse in its single test, but evidence remains thin with only 1 test.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, choose_path layout, finish copy, home new_flow, and home wait_info as each has only been tested once.
